{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black tailored blazer, structured cut, cropped length at the waistline, charcoal gray, wool blend with a subtle herringbone weave.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, fluid drape, full length to ankle, deep espresso brown, heavy cotton twill with slight stretch.
White crisp button-down shirt, classic collar, long length tucked in, pure white, smooth poplin fabric.
Black leather loafers, soft sole, standard length reaching the arch, polished black, calfskin leather.
Simple gold hoop earrings, medium circle diameter, fixed length on a thin wire, yellow gold, lightweight metal.
This outfit works because it honors your request for a restrained and classic look while maintaining the sharpness required for a smart dress code at a rock concert. The structured blazer and wide-leg trousers create a powerful silhouette that allows you to stand confidently in a crowd without blending into the background. The earthy tones of charcoal and espresso brown ground the artificial club lighting, ensuring you look polished yet approachable throughout the evening event."}
